entities.name: Halil Şerif Pasha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Khalil Sherif Pasha, transliterated variously as Halil Şerif Pasha, was an Ottoman-Egyptian statesman, diplomat and art collector, who lived during the Tanzimat period. His collection was described by Théophile Gautier as "the first ever to be formed by a child of Islam". He was furthermore involved in diplomatic affairs following the aftermath of the Crimean War. He also served as the Ottoman Minister of Foreign Affairs.
